lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gills, transitioning into a more dispersed distribution along the posterior lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge running across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high pixel intensity on the dorsal side and deep shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Moderate density of high-luminance blobs concentrated at the base and central region of the first dorsal fin silhouette, with no visible spots along the distal posterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent white linear scar or lesion is visible extending vertically/diagonally across the flank immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit. Irregular notching is visible on the posterior edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple Echeneidae (remoras) attached to the ventral surface and swimming in close proximity to the pectoral fin.
